features.name: Fast Hands
features.desc: As your Cunning Action (Bonus Action), you can also make a Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) check, use Thieves' Tools to disarm a trap or open a lock, or take the Utilize action.

features.name: Second-Story Work
features.desc: Climbing doesn't cost you extra movement; the distance of your running jumps increases by a number of feet equal to your Dexterity modifier.

features.name: Supreme Sneak
features.desc: While you are hidden, you can expend Sneak Attack dice: for each die expended, such an attack deals an extra 1d6 damage, and you remain hidden while moving.

features.name: Use Magic Device
features.desc: You can attune to 4 magic items; you can use Spell Scrolls (even of spells not on your list) and items with charges at less risk.

features.name: Thief's Reflexes
features.desc: In the first round of combat, you take two turns: your normal turn and a second one at your Initiative minus 10 (you can't do this if you are Surprised).
